parameters.query: SELECT u.id AS "userId", u.email, u."fullName", COALESCE(d.name, 'Toàn công ty') AS department, u.role, '2026-Q4' AS period, '28 hàng tháng' AS deadline, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS "hasSubmitted" FROM users u LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = u."departmentId" LEFT JOIN feedbacks f ON (f."revieweeId" = u.id OR f."reviewerId" = u.id) AND f.period = '2026-Q4' WHERE u."isActive" = true ORDER BY u."fullName" ASC;
